g.text: SERVED FROM POSTGRES — precomputed at ingest
AND re-parses for the session list
the capture policy that was in force
shas read from the stored validation_results —
the tab no longer re-derives the gate with a live
runValidation, so both surfaces quote one answer
check 8 on the stripped blob reaches

g.title: stamp
g.text: inside the cached region, so it costs
once per parse, never once per read
root key from the server's own

g.title: recon
g.text: replays edits to rebuild file content, tagging every
line typed / pasted / external. Answers in THREE states:
determinate · concurrent · unknown — the server route
empty body rather than linearizing two clocks.

g.title: note
g.text: The .slog files inside the stored blob ARE the
event stream. Dropping the table removed what had
been the dominant, never-purged storage cost —
and the LRU cache is what makes re-parsing viable.
